notes:
PASS on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check MHS/drivers/robots/seohongpark__ocbench --backend fake (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed (driver.lock.json reviewed_by null); no hardware was attached and the hardware backend was never run. The package targets block-cpu-single-task1-v0 with native ocbench.envs.block_env:BlockEnv, one of the card's AST entry symbols; the card's family-config decision and GymnasiumDriver helper express the interface, so there is no deviation from the card. The fake backend is a pure-Python stand-in for the MuJoCo environment: it reproduces the seven-value Box(-1, 1) action space, the 28-value single-cube observation layout (6 joint positions, 6 joint velocities, 3 effector positions, cos/sin effector yaw, scaled gripper opening, gripper contact, and the cube's 3 positions + 4 quaternion values + cos/sin yaw) and the registered 1250-step truncation, but it models no contacts, actuator forces, inverse kinematics, task success, reward or termination, and it was never compared with upstream. The sim backend (gymnasium.make('block-cpu-single-task1-v0', env_type='single', task_id=1) after importing ocbench) was not run because MuJoCo, dm_control, Gymnasium and ocbench are not installed where the gate runs. Expected warnings: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (it only sets the seed used by the next reset); four G8.NO_UNIT for the bridge-derived inputs (seed twice, ticks, action.values[*]). No G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warning was emitted. Only cap.world.reset.v1, cap.world.step.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 are used, so there are no extension ids and no catalogue_requests. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run; gate.digest is the digest the check printed.
